lessons: Split into stems that each stay under the 1500-inserted-line budget. The pure move added 2384 lines in total: serve_rig 447, admission 567, lifecycle 430, kill 327, notify 209, dispatch 207, upgrade 185.
Stem 1: create tests/integration/serve_rig.py and point the 10 importer files at it. Leave the tests in test_serve.py and have it import its helpers from serve_rig. This is about 460 inserted lines.

Later stems each move one or two themed files out of test_serve.py, for example lifecycle+kill (~757 lines), then admission+notify (~776), then upgrade+dispatch (~392). The last stem deletes test_serve.py. Fence each stem to only the files it touches.
Rewrite acceptance criterion 2 for each stem to cover only the tests that stem moves. Note that the base test_serve.py has 50 test functions, not the 45 the ticket states.
